name: Gear Up By Design, LLC

about:
Gear Up By Design, LLC operates as a full-service print shop in Las Vegas, Nevada. The company emphasizes over 35 years of industry experience, though a specific founding year and founder names are not disclosed. Ownership details such as family, veteran, or woman-owned status are not publicly stated.

The shop provides screen printing, embroidery, direct-to-film (DTF) printing, DTF gang sheets, promotional products, fundraiser programs, and custom branded online stores. All production is kept in-house using specialized equipment for premium apparel printing. Facility size, headcount, and annual volume figures are not published.

The company serves corporate clients seeking brand consistency and team unity, schools and organizations running fundraisers with custom spirit wear, and healthcare facilities needing embroidered scrubs and white coats with precise credentialing. Promotional items such as tote bags and drinkware extend branding beyond apparel.

Gear Up By Design positions itself as a solid trusted partner, citing an A+ Better Business Bureau rating and a focus on long-term relationships with high-end clients. The team highlights its 35-plus years of expertise, in-house control from start to finish, and fast turnaround times with free local pickup on DTF gang sheets as key differentiators.
